# Aksa Nur Irwan

> Senior Flutter & FlutterFlow developer from Indonesia with 5+ years of mobile app development. Builds iOS and Android MVPs for startups, and fixes, scales and migrates FlutterFlow apps already in production.

Highlights:
- Built the FlutterFlow MVP that helped a US startup raise $164,000 in seed funding.
- Shipped Flutter apps with 10,000+ active users.
- 80+ products delivered for clients in 20+ countries; ranked in the top 1% of FlutterFlow developers on Upwork.
- Clients include Tecreat, 90MIN GYM (Qatar) and SSapps.

## Services
- [Mobile app development](https://aksanurirwan.com/#services): iOS and Android apps in Flutter, from MVP to production.
- [FlutterFlow development](https://aksanurirwan.com/#services): fast MVPs with custom Dart code, plus FlutterFlow to Flutter migration.
- [Web apps & dashboards](https://aksanurirwan.com/#services): secure, data-driven operational platforms.
- [AI & automation](https://aksanurirwan.com/#services): OpenAI and Gemini features, workflow automation and backend services.

## Stack
Flutter, Dart, FlutterFlow, BLoC, Riverpod, Provider, Firebase, Supabase, Node.js, RevenueCat, Stripe, OpenAI / Gemini APIs.

## Selected work
- [Ahai App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ahaai.mathsnap): AI homework help for STEM.
- 90 Min Gym: booking platform for gym and personal-trainer sessions in Doha, Qatar (Flutter, React, Supabase, Firebase).
- 100+ Fast Reflex Mini Games: reflex game collection with leaderboards (Godot, Unity, Flutter).
